caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled “Coherency” illustrates GEMBA-SQM coherency scores for four prompt variants labeled V1 through V4. The categories are shown on the horizontal axis as V1, V2, V3, and V4 in that left-to-right order, with no additional axis label displayed. The vertical axis represents the coherency score on the GEMBA-SQM and is shown on a linear scale spanning approximately 85 to 100, with labeled tick marks at regular 2-point intervals (86, 88, 90, 92, 94, 96, 98, 100). There are four single, solid-color bars: V1 is blue with a value label of 93.69, V2 is orange with a value label of 93.8, V3 is green with a value label of 94.5, and V4 is purple with a value label of 91.1. Each bar has its numeric value annotated just above the bar top, and the chart includes light horizontal dashed gridlines; the bars are not stacked or grouped beyond being a single series, and there is no legend or special visual emphasis indicating sorting beyond the displayed V1–V4 sequence.
